_about: The image slots: label, size limit (MB), largest width or height (px), help, and the modes that can have their own image (email and print logos and the sharing image only have a light one). no_svg lists the slots that can't take SVG, and why.

logo_main.label: Main logo
logo_main.help: Your logo in the site header, beside or instead of the site name. Most sites only need this one: every other logo version below uses it when left empty.

logo_stacked.label: Stacked logo
logo_stacked.help: Your symbol above your name, for narrow spaces such as a phone-width header or a sidebar. capy-theme doesn't show it on its own pages: your project's templates use it with {% theme_logo slot="stacked" %}. Leave it empty to use the main logo.

logo_mark.label: Logo mark
logo_mark.help: Just the symbol, without the name, for tight spots such as an app bar, an avatar or a footer. Your project's templates use it with {% theme_logo slot="mark" %}. Leave it empty to use the main logo.

logo_wordmark.label: Wordmark
logo_wordmark.help: Just the name in lettering, without the symbol, for places that already show the symbol. Your project's templates use it with {% theme_logo slot="wordmark" %}. Leave it empty to use the main logo.

logo_email.label: Email logo
logo_email.help: For the HTML emails your site sends. Email programs don't show SVG, so use a PNG or JPEG; and emails have no dark mode, so there's only a light version. Your project's email templates get it from the theme artifacts. Leave it empty to use the main logo.

logo_print.label: Print logo
logo_print.help: A high-resolution version (up to 6000 px) for printed pages, PDFs or invoices. Print has no dark mode, so there's only a light version. Your project's templates use it with {% theme_logo slot="print" %}. Leave it empty to use the main logo.

icon.label: Icon
icon.help: One square image (at least 512 × 512 px is best). The browser tab icon, home-screen and app icons are all made from it when you publish.

social.label: Social sharing image
social.help: Shown when someone shares a link to your site (link previews in chat apps and social sites). It's cropped to 1200 × 630 from its center. Your project's templates or another module add the preview tags.

background_login.label: Login background
background_login.help: A picture behind the login page. It shows where your project's templates use class="capy-bg-login" or the CSS variable --capy-bg-login.

background_pattern.label: Page background pattern
background_pattern.help: A small image repeated behind pages. It shows where your project's templates use class="capy-bg-pattern" or the CSS variable --capy-bg-pattern.

no_svg.social: Social sites don't accept SVG for link previews
no_svg.icon: Favicons and app icons are made from it as PNGs
